 Sulinass: Al Faisaly's chances are lower against Al Nassr
 Wednesday 21-10-2026 
 محمد أبو ريان 
 Al Faisaly host Al Nassr on Friday evening at the Majmaah Sports City Stadium in the 11th round of the Saudi Pro League, in a match where Al Nassr aim to continue their pursuit of the league title, while the home side hope to turn the expectations around.
 Solinas stated in the press conference ahead of the match that the odds lean towards Al Nassr, but he assured that his players will give their all for a satisfactory result, pointing out that the outcome will depend on what both teams present on the pitch.
 Al Faisaly's coach addressed the issue of establishing a fixed lineup, explaining that the pressure of matches and their close scheduling make player rotation essential to provide them with rest and maintain their readiness, while ensuring that all team members are prepared to participate.
 Solinas revealed that Christian Bassogog will be absent against Al Nassr due to the injury he sustained during the last match against Al Shabab, confirming that he will look for a suitable replacement to compensate for his absence in a tough encounter that requires all players to be ready.
 Giovani Solinas, the Al-Faisaly coach, acknowledged the difficulty of the upcoming match against Al-Nassr, confirming that his opponent has greater chances of winning according to predictions. However, he emphasized that his team will fight on the pitch in search of a positive result.
